speaker: Ms Hany Soh
text: asked the Minister for Health (a) how many of the hospitals in Singapore currently practice continuous monitoring of vital signs on babies who are admitted to its neonatal intensive care units and special care nurseries; and (b) whether other hospitals, apart from KKH, intend to also review and enhance its monitoring procedures for newborns, in particular those born premature or with medical conditions.

speaker: Ms Hany Soh (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
text: Apart from enhancing the monitoring procedures, I hope that the Ministry of Health can also consider having a standard operating procedure in place whereby the hospitals are providing neonatal parental support where it is automatically activated to ensure that the helpless parents are assured of the procedures that will be in place and the essential resources available to assist them.
